values: Assigned inspection/evidence, verified findings, immutable report review/release, maintenance, rework, and post-service milestones.
Assigned Inspector starts the inspection and completes the required checklist.
Sign in as the accepted assignee; start the inspection; load the checklist; save a required response; reload it; try the checklist as another Inspector and an Inspector from another organization.
Start is retry-safe; the published checklist and saved value/timestamp are returned to the assignee; both out-of-scope Inspectors receive INSPECTION_SCOPE_DENIED.
Active Inspector owns an accepted assignment; the checklist is published.

Full backend mvnw verify passed 134 tests with JaCoCo and Modulith checks. InspectionWorkflowTest covers assignment/start/checklist rules; EvidenceApiIntegrationTest.returnsChecklistAndSavedResponseOnlyToTheAcceptedAssignee verifies the HTTP read/save contract and both denial paths; mobile assignment/repository/capture tests passed.
Assigned Inspector uploads supported evidence with checksum and source traceability.
Upload a valid PNG from the started inspection; retry the same bytes; list and stream evidence as the assignee; submit corrupt content and read as out-of-scope Inspectors.

Object-store bytes and PostgreSQL metadata remain consistent; checksum/source/uploader are server-traceable; retry is idempotent; corrupt content is rejected and unrelated Inspectors receive INSPECTION_SCOPE_DENIED.
Inspection is in progress; PostgreSQL and an S3-compatible test endpoint are available (S3Mock in CI; MinIO for runtime verification); a supported image is available.

The 2026-09-24 full backend verification passed using real PostgreSQL and MinIO containers. GitHub Actions run 36090635549 initially failed before tests because the MinIO image pull was unauthorized. After switching the test containers to S3Mock 5.2.3, full backend verify run 36092639825 passed: EvidenceApiIntegrationTest (3 tests) and MinioEvidenceObjectStoreIntegrationTest (1 test) both passed. S3Mock covers the S3 API subset and is not a MinIO server test. The post-change local targeted run could not start because the Docker Desktop API pipe was unavailable.
Inspector verifies AI candidates or records a manual finding.

Send eligible evidence to the deterministic inference stub; verify candidate provenance; confirm, modify, and reject candidates; create a manual finding; exercise inference failure and inspect official report findings.

Candidate decisions are scoped and auditable; only verified/manual findings become official; pending/rejected candidates stay non-official; an inference failure leaves evidence and manual entry usable.
Eligible evidence exists; deterministic inference stub and authorized Inspector are available.

AiFindingServiceTest and AiFindingApiIntegrationTest passed with state/scope coverage; YoloInferenceClientTest and configuration tests passed using a local HTTP stub. No deployed/live YOLO model was connected; this result verifies the configured adapter contract and deterministic workflow.
Report progresses through independent review, release, and Client decision.

Compose a draft from checklist/evidence/verified findings; deny author self-review; assign a distinct reviewer; record review; release as Manager; verify Client draft isolation; accept or request revision and retry acceptance.

Reviewer/Manager/Client scopes are enforced; only released versions are Client-visible; revision creates an auditable decision; acceptance locks the version, records actor/reason, and emits one handoff.
Inspection data is complete; distinct active author/reviewer and Manager exist; Client belongs to the owning organization.

InspectionReportServiceTest and InspectionReportApiIntegrationTest passed for version lifecycle, review separation, visibility, release, Client decision, immutability, and single accepted-report event. Migration V10 persists Client decision actor/reason. Report API integration uses a test object-store stub; real MinIO byte storage is verified separately by WF3-002 integration tests.

Approval, rework/reinspection, and post-service billing status are recorded.

Approval or rework state is auditable; reinspection is a new controlled step; payment status is recorded without requiring an online gateway.
Maintenance result and invoice record exist.
